# FicWrapped

> FicWrapped is a free, fan-made AO3 Wrapped: it reads a reader's Archive of Our Own (AO3) History in their own browser and turns it into shareable year-in-review cards (top fandoms, ships, characters, tags, most-reread fic, reading by month, reader type). It never asks for the AO3 password and uploads nothing. A bookmarklet works on desktop and mobile browsers; a paste mode works anywhere. An optional $3.99 Supporter Pack adds a printable poster and a CSV/offline export of the loaded History. AO3 has no official Wrapped. Not affiliated with the OTW or AO3.

## How FicWrapped counts (checked 2026-11-25)
- Where the data comes from: Your AO3 History, the page at archiveofourown.org/users/your-name/readings. AO3 lists 20 works per page, most recently visited first, and only shows it to you while you're logged in.
- Which fics count for 2026: A fic counts for 2026 if you last opened it in 2026. AO3 keeps only the latest visit date, so a fic you read in March and reopened in October counts in October.
- Fics: Each work counts once, however many times you opened it. Works you opened but didn't finish still count: AO3 records visits, not finished reads.
- Words: The work's full word count as shown on AO3, not the chapters you actually read.
- Visits: AO3's own "Visited N times" counter for each work, which is how the most-reread card is chosen.
- Deleted works: Counted separately. AO3 keeps only the date for them, so they aren't in the fandom or tag totals.
- Reading time: Total words ÷ 250 words a minute.
- Speed: The bookmark reads about one History page a second. If AO3 asks it to slow down, it waits and carries on.
- What you need: An AO3 account, logged in, with History switched on (AO3 Preferences → Turn on History).

## Pages
- [Tool: make your AO3 Wrapped](https://ficwrapped.pages.dev/)
- [How do I do AO3 Wrapped?](https://ficwrapped.pages.dev/how-to-do-ao3-wrapped/): Step-by-step: make your AO3 Wrapped 2026 from your AO3 History with a bookmark, without giving anyone your password. Takes about a minute.
- [How do I get AO3 Wrapped on my phone?](https://ficwrapped.pages.dev/ao3-wrapped-on-phone/): Make your AO3 Wrapped on an iPhone, iPad or Android phone: save the FicWrapped bookmark in Safari or Chrome, or paste your History pages. No password, no app.
- [Can I export my AO3 History?](https://ficwrapped.pages.dev/ao3-history-export/): AO3 has no export button for History or Marked for Later. Here's how to see your AO3 History and save it as a spreadsheet or offline page with links to every fic.
- [Is AO3 Wrapped safe to use?](https://ficwrapped.pages.dev/is-ao3-wrapped-safe/): AO3 Wrapped tools work in different ways: some ask for your password, some run notebooks, some run in your browser. What each method can see, and how to stay safe.
- [Privacy and refunds](https://ficwrapped.pages.dev/privacy/)
